When does your mortgage deal end?

Most people find out when the letter lands. By then, the time to compare options is already running short.

A simple habit: note the end date now, and start looking around six months before it ends.

For employers, this is one of the easiest ways to make a real difference to your people's finances. Through Get Perks, your team get free mortgage advice from brokers who do the work.

getperks.co.uk

Your home may be repossessed if you do not keep up repayments on your mortgage.
